Triangle LED Lamp
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes TriangleLamp --x 180 --h 30 --cornersize 25 --screenholesize 3 --screwholesize 1.5 --sharpcorners 1 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes TriangleLamp --x --h --cornersize --screenholesize --screwholesize --sharpcorners --thickness --reference --labels
